nodes.name: JB-02 Stand-01

nodes.name: JB-03 Robot ForeArm / J4

nodes.name: J4 M12-8 EMH logic

nodes.name: J4 M12-4 EMH power

nodes.name: EAOT-01-EMH84

nodes.name: PBS-03 Servo-01
nodes.description: C-03 M12-8 from JB-02. C-14 HMI leaves here.

nodes.name: PBS-04 Servo-02

nodes.name: JB-03-HMI-02

nodes.name: FD-02 LimitSwitch

nodes.name: FD-05 BeltSolenoid
nodes.description: C-09 P-04 Black Belt FWD shared T2 Q5 / doBelt.FWD | doLamp.BeltFWD.

nodes.name: FD-06 Strobe-01

nodes.name: FD-01 EthernetSwitch
nodes.description: C-05 M12-5 52 V from JB-02. HOLD.

cables.notes: Field-true: P-01 White = Mag, P-02 Brown = Demag. Status pins 4–8 open / no C-10 home.

cables.notes: P-01 Brown +24, P-02 White 0V, P-03 Blue 0V, P-04 Black +24. Buzz polarity.

cables.name: M12-5 HMI (was C-12)

cables.name: M12-5 strobe (was C-13)

cables.name: M12-5 door
cables.notes: JB-02 TB5-9 → FD-02 P-04 Black. Continues on C-10 P-04.

cables.name: M12-5 belt solenoid
cables.notes: JB-02 TB7-4 → FD-05 P-04. Shared T2 Q5.

cables.name: Forearm Mag jumper
cables.notes: JB-03 R23-09 + R23-13 → J4 M12-8 panel P1 (White Mag).

cables.name: Forearm Demag jumper
cables.notes: JB-03 R23-08 + R23-14 → J4 M12-8 panel P2 (Brown Demag).

cables.name: Forearm EMH 0V jumper
cables.notes: R23-12 0V → J4 M12-4 panel P2 and M12-8 P3.

meta.notes: RAIV-T3 electrical recovery. Controller F-24-0064095-C-002. App PlateSorter. C-10 is the only 25c homerun. C-11 is R23-19 arm feed (not a second 25c). C-12 M12-8 EMH logic: P-01 White Mag, P-02 Brown Demag. C-13 M12-4 EMH power. C-14 HMI and C-15 strobe are the old C-12/C-13 jackets renumbered. T3 Q0–Q3 carry T2 safety-stop names (doSafteyStop.None/Waiting/SS1/SS2) with no C-10 home. Mag path: C-10 P-06 → TB10-5 → C-11 P-09+P-13 → C-12 P-01 White. Demag path: C-10 P-05 → TB10-6 → C-11 P-08+P-14 → C-12 P-02 Brown.
